canonical_project: Dover SM1A South Morang data centre
owner: Dover DC / PVAC Development Pty Ltd
notes: Victorian ministerial permit PA2402997 covers use/development of land for a data centre at 525 and 535 McDonalds Road and 765 Plenty Road, South Morang, with permit granted 2024-09-12 and amendments approved 2025-06-02 and 2025-10-30. Dover identifies the SM1A project as up to 120MW, with construction expected late 2026/early 2027.
